content_sections.heading: Gandevi Bank Clerk Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
Gandevi Bank Clerk Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility is assessed as on 10 August 2026. Candidates must be domiciled in Gujarat State and must produce relevant original documents (with a photocopy) in support of their identity and eligibility, as and when called for. No change in the category, age, educational qualification, or other details provided during online registration will be permitted at any stage after submission of the application. The minimum qualification for recruitment to the Clerical cadre is a Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university with at least 55% marks. However: Candidates holding a Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) degree are not eligible . Candidates holding degrees in Engineering are also not eligible , except those holding a degree in Information Technology or Computer Science (BE/B.Tech or equivalent). Candidates who have passed CA Intermediate or CMA Intermediate are also eligible. All educational qualifications must be from a recognised University/Institution, with the result declared on or before 10 August 2026 (proper documentary proof of the result declaration date must be submitted at the time of interview). The date of passing the qualifying examination will be reckoned as the date of passing appearing on the mark sheet/provisional certificate. Candidates should also have knowledge of Gujarati, English, and Computers. Note on a second discrepancy in the source notification: The Eligibility section states that the qualifying result must be declared on or before 10.08.2026 , while a separate clause in the Interview Documents section (item e) refers to the result being declared on or before 01.08.2026 . This inconsistency exists in the official notification and has been reproduced here without alteration; candidates should confirm the correct cut-off date with the Bank. The notification does not mention any age relaxation for reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-servicemen, etc.); this detail is not specified.

content_sections.heading: Gandevi Bank Clerk Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection consists of an Online Written Examination followed by a Personal Interview. A candidate must qualify in both the Online Examination and the Interview to be considered for the subsequent recruitment process. All test papers will be available only in English. The Bank reserves the right to modify the structure of the examination, which will be intimated through its website. A penalty of 1/4th of the marks assigned to a question is applied for each wrong answer (negative marking). Test-wise and total scores are reported with decimal points up to two digits, and scores may be equated across sessions to adjust for minor differences in difficulty level. The examination will tentatively be conducted in online mode at Surat, Vapi, and Vadodara. No request for change of examination centre will be entertained. The Bank reserves the right to cancel any examination centre, add other centres, or allot a candidate to a centre other than the one opted for, at its discretion. Candidates will appear for the examination at their own risk and expense. Candidates shortlisted in the online examination will be called for a Personal Interview, to be conducted at Gandevi only. The centre, venue address, date, and time of the interview will be communicated through the interview call letter, downloadable from the Bank's website. Any request for a change in date/centre of the interview will not be entertained, though the Bank reserves the right to change these at its discretion under unforeseen circumstances.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Gandevi Peoples Co-operative Bank Clerk recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Gandevi Peoples Co-operative Bank Clerk positions is 31st August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 13 vacancies announced for the Clerk position in the Gandevi Peoples Co-operative Bank recruitment drive for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree with at least 55% marks. Degrees in BA and most Engineering disciplines are excluded, except for IT/CS. CA/CMA Intermediate qualifications are also accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Clerk position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Clerk post is 28 years, calculated as of 10th August 2026. Age relaxation details are not provided in the current information.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the Gandevi Peoples Co-operative Bank Clerk recruitment is entirely online. Interested and eligible candidates need to apply through the bank's official website.

faq.question: Q6. Which degrees are excluded from the eligibility criteria for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: Bachelor of Arts (BA) degrees are explicitly excluded. Most Engineering degrees are also not eligible, with the exception of those in Information Technology or Computer Science.
